subject: Message-definition protocol and record metadata
claim: In r806919.Wizard_1_610, all 29 message protocol definitions carry ServiceID, ProtocolType, ProtocolVersion and ProtocolDescription; their message records also carry the typed metadata fields and NOXFER attributes counted here.
how_to_repeat: Run Ambrose's `client wad --list Messages --client <install>` against your own install and keep the entries ending in .xml.
Read those entries from Root.wad with `client wad <entry> --client <install>`; do not launch Wizard101 or contact a server.

In PowerShell parse each output with System.Xml.XmlReader, DtdProcessing set to Prohibit and XmlResolver set to null; count _ProtocolInfo/RECORD child names, their TYPE attributes and protocol versions, and record only trimmed description lengths rather than description text.

For each message RECORD, count metadata child names beginning with an underscore, their TYPE and NOXFER attributes, non-empty values and trimmed value lengths; count attributes and non-empty text on the remaining field elements without recording their values.
Run `client messages --list --client <install>` and confirm it exits successfully with 1,448 message-definition lines as a cross-check.
evidence: The archive reader identified the user's own Steam install as r806919.Wizard_1_610; all inputs came from that install's Root.wad.

The 29 XML definitions each contain one _ProtocolInfo/RECORD with ServiceID, ProtocolType, ProtocolVersion and ProtocolDescription. Every version is 1; every trimmed description is non-empty, with lengths from 12 to 54.
The protocol-info element types are ServiceID UBYT, ProtocolType STR, ProtocolVersion INT and ProtocolDescription STR; each type is carried by a TYPE attribute on all 29 definitions.
The protocol rows are listed below as service id, protocol type, version and description length; description text is not included.
The XML census counted 1,448 message records, and Ambrose's `client messages --list` exited successfully and returned 1,448 lines.

Across those records, _MsgName and _MsgHandler each occur 1,448 times; _MsgDescription occurs 1,448 times and is non-empty 1,392 times; _MsgAccessLvl occurs 14 times; _MsgOrder 32 times; and _MsgType 4 times. Every such metadata element has TYPE and NOXFER attributes; the first three use STR, and the last three use UBYT.
The 4,315 non-metadata field elements have 10 non-empty text defaults. Their attributes are TYPE 4,312 times, TPYE once and TYP once; no other field attributes occur.
disproof: A repeat read of r806919.Wizard_1_610 shows a different protocol field, version, description length, metadata type or NOXFER attribute count.
